instruction: Adjust the spreadsheet cells to fit on a single page and convert it to PDF format for easy sharing. Maintain the PDF filename identical to the spreadsheet name and save it in the home folder.

metadata.explanation: Task variation with rephrased instruction. Agent must resize cells to fit content on one page and export to PDF. Evaluator checks PDF exists in /home/user/ and has exactly 1 page, with file size > 10KB to ensure content is present.
metadata.verification_details: Uses existing check_pdf_pages metric to verify: (1) PDF file exists at /home/user/Resize_Cells_Fit_Page.pdf, (2) PDF has exactly 1 page (relation=eq, ref_value=1), (3) PDF file size > 10KB (verify_content=True). No custom functions needed as check_pdf_pages is already available in desktop_env.evaluators.metrics.pdf.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic logic error: check_pdf_pages with verify_content=true checks for images in PDF (pdf.py:46-58), but spreadsheet-to-PDF conversion produces text/vector graphics, not rasterized images
The image check will cause false negatives - valid spreadsheet PDFs without embedded images will fail verification even if the task was completed correctly
LibreOffice Calc exports spreadsheets as PDFs with text content and vector graphics, not as image-based PDFs
Incomplete requirement verification: evaluator only checks page count=1 but doesn't verify that cells were actually adjusted/resized to fit the page
File location, filename, and page count verification are correct and semantically appropriate
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Remove verify_content=true from rules, or modify check_pdf_pages to have a mode that verifies content existence without requiring images (e.g., check for text extraction instead)
Alternative: Create a spreadsheet-specific content verification that checks for text/table content rather than images
Consider adding verification that the PDF content matches the original spreadsheet data (e.g., extract text and verify key values are present)
The core page count logic (relation=eq, ref_value=1) is correct and should be preserved

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_pdf_pages first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
